devdoc.details: Inherits from Ownable, Pausable, and ReentrancyGuard for access control, pausing functionality, and security against reentrancy attacks.

ExchangeRateChanged(address,uint256).details: Emitted when the exchange rate of a token is updated.

params.exchangeRate: The new exchange rate of the token.
params.token: The address of the token whose exchange rate was changed.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Redeemed(address,address,uint256).details: Emitted when a user redeems `fromToken` for a `toToken`.

params.toToken: The address of the token that was redeemed to.
params.user: The address of the user who performed the redemption.

TokenAdded(address,uint256).details: Emitted when a new token is added to the redemption list.

params.exchangeRate: The exchange rate set for the new token.
params.token: The address of the token that was added.

TokenRemoved(address).details: Emitted when a token is removed from the redemption list.

params.token: The address of the token that was removed.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

addToken(address,uint256).details: Ensures the token is not already added and sets its exchange rate based on its decimals.

params.exchangeRate: The exchange rate of the new token.
params.token: The address of the token being added.

calculateRedeem(uint256).details: Ensures that each calculated redeemable amount is greater than zero.

params.amount: The amount of `fromToken` to be redeemed.

returns._1: uint256[] An array of redeemable amounts for each `toToken`.

params._exchangeRates: An array of exchange rates corresponding to each `toToken`.
params._fromToken: The ERC20 token that users will redeem from.
params._toTokens: An array of ERC20 token addresses that users can redeem to.

emergencyWithdraw(address).details: Transfers the entire balance of the specified `token` to the contract owner.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: If the contract is paused, it will be unpaused and vice versa.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

redeem(uint256).details: Transfers `amount` of `fromToken` from the caller to the contract, then distributes equivalent `toTokens` based on exchange rates.

params.amount: The amount of `fromToken` to be redeemed.

removeToken(uint256).details: Deletes the exchange rate and removes the token from the `toTokens` array.

params.index: The index of the token being removed.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setExchangeRate(address,uint256).details: Updates the exchange rate based on the token's decimals.

params.exchangeRate: The new exchange rate of the token.
params.token: The address of the token for which the exchange rate is being set.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

exchangeRates.details: Mapping from target token address to its exchange rate.

fromDenominator.details: Denominator based on the decimals of `fromToken` used for exchange rate calculations.

fromToken.details: The ERC20 token users can redeem from.

toTokens.details: List of ERC20 tokens users can redeem to.

devdoc.title: Redemption

addToken(address,uint256).notice: Adds a new supported ERC20 token with its exchange rate.

calculateRedeem(uint256).notice: Calculates the amounts of each `toToken` that can be redeemed for a given `fromToken` amount.

constructor.notice: Initializes the Redemption contract with the specified tokens and their exchange rates.

emergencyWithdraw(address).notice: Withdraws all of a specific ERC20 token to the owner in case of emergency.

pause().notice: Toggles the paused state of the contract.

redeem(uint256).notice: Redeems a specified amount of `fromToken` for each supported `toToken`.

removeToken(uint256).notice: Removes a supported ERC20 token by its index.

setExchangeRate(address,uint256).notice: Sets the exchange rate for a supported ERC20 token.

userdoc.notice: Allows users to redeem a specific ERC20 token (`fromToken`) for multiple other ERC20 tokens (`toTokens`) based on predefined exchange rates.
